response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS type_count FROM transactionrecord AS r JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref COLLATE BINARY = t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT AVG(type_count) AS average_count, SUM(type_count) AS total_count FROM type_counts) SELECT c.trader_type, c.type_count, 1.0 * c.type_count / totals.total_count AS share, c.type_count - totals.average_count AS above_average_by FROM type_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals WHERE totals.average_count IS NOT NULL AND c.type_count > totals.average_count

assumptions.assumption: Each matched transaction record contributes one to its trader type’s count.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct trader accounts represented by matched transaction records, rather than transaction records.
